677:t_103:6.en:
$$シリウス$$
「Stay out of it, $$シルヴィア$$. This is how $$アポロ$$ and $$ミカゲ$$ settle things between them.」

677:t_103:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... As expected of the one who inherited the Mechanical Angel... And the man I once believed in...」

677:t_103:8.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Here I come, $$ミカゲ$$! I'm going to punch you out and end this right here!」

677:t_103:9.en:
$$アポロ$$
「And for the sake of $$頭翅#pilot$$, who's waiting for you!」

677:t_104:0.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Stop it, $$ミカゲ$$! You are...」

677:t_104:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「The $$セリアン$$ who was your past life must surely have had a kind heart too...」

677:t_104:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! You came here to...」

677:t_104:5.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Say nothing. Besides, even I have no intention of dying in vain.」

677:t_104:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Now come, $$ミコノ$$! The battles ahead cannot be won through kindness alone!」

677:t_104:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「...I'm coming, $$ミカゲ$$. I will end your days of fighting!」

677:t_105:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$ミカゲ$$! You spread hatred in the name of love. I'm going to stop you!」

677:t_105:1.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Heh heh... My love may indeed have been twisted...」

677:t_105:3.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You, the girl with the spring-green hair, the girl with the pale pink and gold hair... That triangle goes on in a different shape, becoming one of trust and friendship...」

677:t_105:4.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Surely that is the form in which a defeated love is properly sublimated...」

677:t_105:6.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「But even I have the pride of a $$堕天翅$$. I have no intention of losing to a mere Wingless.」

677:t_105:7.en:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Come, boy who set his feelings on wings! Surpass me with that power, if you can!」

677:t_105:8.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's a showdown, $$ミカゲ$$! My wings cut through the wind faster than the wings of an $$天翅$$!」

677:t_106:0.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「I have plenty to say to you, who took my freedom and made me a tool...!」

677:t_106:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「But none of that matters anymore! To protect $$ランカ$$ and the world, I'll strike you down here!」

677:t_107:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「Why won't you try to understand each other!? You know how to communicate with the $$バジュラ$$, and you turn it into a power to rule them!」

677:t_107:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Beings like you are what spread war across the universe! For the $$バジュラ$$'s sake too, we stop you here!」
